name: Ai Identity Requires Population Level Compositional Governance
text: Self-sovereign identity and verifiable credentials can establish which AI entities are participating without a central identity authority, but governance of multiple versions and instantiations also requires a representation of how their operational states, population weights, and configurations change over time; convex AI compositionality proposes such a representation while preserving formal identity relations under stated lifecycle-reachability conditions.
scope_conditions: finite populations of related AI systems or instantiations
operational states admitting the proposed convex representation
formal identity preservation only under the framework's stated conditions
conceptual and illustrative support rather than demonstrated governance effectiveness
The position is Kaal's own cross-domain application of the cited claim; the source's authors do not make it.
The source passage is taken from the arXiv abstract; the full paper was not reviewed.
